title: Fault Tolerance

searches.query: "Fault Tolerance" system design interview correlated failure recovery
searches.result: success; exact-concept search executed, but independent frequency/rank/company evidence was insufficient; prompts are original production adaptations and technical decisions use checked primary sources

sources.title: Azure Well-Architected: Disaster recovery
sources.supportRationale: Explicit recovery objectives, failure-domain planning and tested recovery; examples are illustrative rather than provider promises.

sources.title: Google SRE: Addressing cascading failures
sources.supportRationale: Correlated overload, failure propagation, recovery capacity and controlled testing.

sources.title: Google SRE: Handling overload
sources.supportRationale: Capacity, bounded queues, load shedding and retry-aware overload reasoning.

sources.title: Ongaro and Ousterhout: Raft extended paper
sources.supportRationale: Terms, persistent votes, election/log safety and membership assumptions in the original Raft protocol.

scenarios.theme: Three replicas disappear together. Was the service fault tolerant?
scenarios.assumptions: They ran in one failure domain and the requirement covered loss of that domain. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Fault Tolerance to shared zone.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: Three replicas disappear together. Was the service fault tolerant?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Place enough independent capacity/state across the required domains, inspect shared dependencies and validate the full routing/authority path under a domai

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: More domains add cost and coordination latency

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Independence must match the assumed failure; separate hosts alone do not address regional or shared-credential failure.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to dr, cascade; interview frequency is not claimed.

full-delivery.rationale: Three labeled parts are self-contained; native disclosure and host confidence integration use stable keys.

scenarios.theme: Failover works, then the healthy region collapses. What changes?
scenarios.assumptions: The surviving region receives normal traffic plus cold-cache loads and retries. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Fault Tolerance to survivor overload.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: Failover works, then the healthy region collapses. What changes?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Apply bounded admission/degradation, ramp traffic and test capacity under the full recovery mix

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Reserve capacity costs money and shedding affects users

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Adding instances may arrive too late or overload a shared database, so measure downstream and startup constraints.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to cascade, overload; interview frequency is not claimed.

full-delivery.rationale: Three labeled parts are self-contained; native disclosure and host confidence integration use stable keys.

scenarios.theme: A bad update reaches every replica. Promote one?
scenarios.assumptions: All replicas contain the same erroneous deletion and the valid data existed yesterday. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Fault Tolerance to corrupt replica.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A bad update reaches every replica. Promote one?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Stop the damaging path, identify a valid recovery point, restore/replay through supported procedures and reconcile later legitimate changes before reopenin

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Historical restoration takes time and may lose/reconcile subsequent work

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Another equally corrupted replica cannot restore the missing truth; backup retention and integrity checks are essential.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to dr; interview frequency is not claimed.

full-delivery.rationale: Three labeled parts are self-contained; native disclosure and host confidence integration use stable keys.

scenarios.theme: The payment dependency is down. Show paid to preserve availability?
scenarios.assumptions: Order tracking can serve some cached information, but payment correctness matters. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Fault Tolerance to unknown payment.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: The payment dependency is down. Show paid to preserve availability?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Return the permitted order details with an explicit unavailable/unknown payment state and disable actions requiring confirmed payment authority

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: A degraded view is less convenient, but inventing success violates the user promise

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: A signed durable prior payment fact may support a narrower statement if its validity is established.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to dr, cascade; interview frequency is not claimed.

full-delivery.rationale: Three labeled parts are self-contained; native disclosure and host confidence integration use stable keys.

scenarios.theme: The backup restores in ten minutes. Is a ten-minute RTO proven?
scenarios.assumptions: Clients still need keys, DNS/routing changes, log replay and correctness checks. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Fault Tolerance to restore objective.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: The backup restores in ten minutes. Is a ten-minute RTO proven?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Measure the end-to-end incident-to-useful-service path with those dependencies and compare the result with the agreed objective

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Full drills consume resources and coordination

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: A narrower database-restore metric can still be useful, but must not be advertised as the whole service recovery objective.

scenarios.theme: The old primary region returns with stale data. Route writes back immediately?
scenarios.assumptions: The recovery region has accepted authoritative updates during the outage. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Fault Tolerance to failback split.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: The old primary region returns with stale data. Route writes back immediately?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Keep one supported authority, reconcile/rebuild the returning state and perform a verified ownership/routing handoff with obsolete writers fenced

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Failback may take longer than connectivity restoration

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: An active-active merge is an alternative only if its consistency/conflict model fits the data; it cannot be improvised after divergent irreversible actions

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to dr, raft; interview frequency is not claimed.
